hook: The menu was just a formality.
setup: A Pizza Bakery date begins like a new decision.
proof: She studies the menu seriously even though pizza and hazelnut cold coffee are the known answer.
bridge: The menu gradually loses power; the repeated choice stops reading as boring and starts reading as being known.
active_zuv_role: He gives her the performance of choosing, then quietly protects the ritual she loves.
send_save_reason: Send to the person who already knows your order.
